question:
Which of the following pair regarding the Ruler of Delhi sultanate period of their rule is correct?

I. Ghiyasuddin Balban - 1266-1287

II. Firuz Shah Tughluq - 1351-1388
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement I: Ghiyasuddin Balban ruled from 1266 to 1287.**

 
 
• Ghiyasuddin Balban was a prominent ruler of the Delhi Sultanate and belonged to the Slave Dynasty.
 
• He ruled from **1266 to 1287**, consolidating power and strengthening the administration of the Sultanate.
 
• Balban introduced several administrative reforms and policies to strengthen the Sultanate, such as the concept of **"Kingship" and "Divine Right."**
 
• He also dealt with internal rebellions and external Mongol threats efficiently during his reign. ***Hence, Statement I is correct.***
 
 
 
• **Statement II: Firuz Shah Tughluq ruled from 1351 to 1388.**
 
 
• Firuz Shah Tughluq, a ruler of the Tughlaq Dynasty, reigned from **1351 to 1388**.
